analysis:
Both supplied units are base_text excerpts of coordinator/api/consumer.go, lines 1-595 and 596 onward. No patch hunk or head-side text was supplied, so the actual PR change is not visible. I could not tell which lines changed, and I report no finding because none can be tied to a changed line.

What the base excerpts show:
- dispatchWithReserver is the single provider dispatch funnel. The sequence is: scan slot, then reserve, then reserveAdditionalForProvider, then check provider.PublicKey, then e2e.ParsePublicKey, then GenerateSessionKeys, then PrepareCacheAttempt, then bodyForCacheAttempt, then e2e.Encrypt. The excerpt cuts off at the Encrypt error path. The provider write and the final App Attest authorization check (T-053, TB-011, A-016) fall outside the supplied text.
- Billing refunds are idempotent through refundProviderExtra and cancelDispatch.
- Circuit-breaker feeds in noteInferenceError treat provider-supplied error text and reasons as untrusted input (ADV-001, T-007).
- Media-fetch gating (T-049) is not visible in the excerpt, because resolveRemoteMedia and the top-up live elsewhere.
- The rawBody used for sealing is passed into dispatchWithReserver. T-049's detection hint flags forwarding a body captured before media inlining as high severity.

The next pass needs the actual diff of consumer.go. It should check:
(1) that the sealed body is the post-inline body;
(2) that the final-dispatch authorization check at the provider write is preserved;
(3) that billing reservation and refund ordering is unchanged;
(4) that plaintext is never sent when encryption fails.

This is a coverage limit, not evidence that the change is safe.
